Preferred Equity Subscriber accepted the rights, duties and obligations set forth in the LLC Agreement and became a preferred member
of the Company.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">As
described above, all of the proceeds from the Preferred Equity Investment were used by the Company to the purchase Bitcoin, which Bitcoin
was held in a custodial account until the Closing, upon which it was contributed to ProCap Financial.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>Sponsor
Earnout Agreement</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">On
December 3, 2025, the Company and Sponsor entered into an agreement (the &#8220;<span style="text-decoration: underline">Sponsor Earnout Agreement</span>&#8221;), providing that
<span id="xdx_90F_eus-gaap--SharesIssued_iI_c20251203__us-gaap--TypeOfArrangementAxis__custom--SponsorEarnoutAgreementMember_zJRWE9nyVSh1" title="Shares issued"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:SharesIssued" contextRef="AsOf2025-12-03_custom_SponsorEarnoutAgreementMember" id="Fact000949" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="Shares">8,333,333</ix:nonFraction></span> shares of Pubco Stock (such shares subject to earnout, the &#8220;<span style="text-decoration: underline">Earnout Founder Shares</span>&#8221;), representing all of
the shares of Pubco Stock issuable to the Sponsor or its transferees in exchange for their Class B ordinary shares of CCCM (&#8220;<span style="text-decoration: underline">Class
B Ordinary Shares</span>&#8221;) upon the Closing, shall be subject to transfer restrictions set forth in the Sponsor Earnout Agreement
(the &#8220;<span style="text-decoration: underline">Sponsor Transfer Restrictions</span>&#8221;) and shall vest and be released from such restriction only if certain price targets
are achieved during the 2-year period following the Closing (the &#8220;<span style="text-decoration: underline">Earnout Period</span>&#8221;).</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Sponsor Earnout Agreement provided that the Earnout Founder Shares shall vest and shall no longer be subject to the Sponsor Transfer
Restrictions as follows:</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#9679;<span id="xdx_90D_ecustom--SharePriceTriggerEventDescription_c20251203__20251203__us-gaap--TypeOfArrangementAxis__custom--SponsorEarnoutAgreementMember_zTbCDwv2ANKg" title="Share price trigger event description"><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2025-12-032025-12-03_custom_SponsorEarnoutAgreementMember" id="Fact000951" name="BRR:SharePriceTriggerEventDescription">100%
of the Earnout Founder Shares will vest and shall no longer be subject to the Sponsor Transfer Restrictions if the closing price of the
Pubco Stock equals or exceeds $10.21 per share (as may be adjusted) for any 20 trading days within any consecutive 30-trading day period
during the Earnout Period</ix:nonNumeric></span> (the &#8220;<span style="text-decoration: underline">Share Price Trigger Event</span>&#8221;).</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#9679;<span id="xdx_900_ecustom--BtcPriceTriggerEventDescription_c20251203__20251203__us-gaap--TypeOfArrangementAxis__custom--SponsorEarnoutAgreementMember_zlCFBwwlopLc" title="BTC price trigger event description"><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2025-12-032025-12-03_custom_SponsorEarnoutAgreementMember" id="Fact000953" name="BRR:BtcPriceTriggerEventDescription">100%
of the Earnout Founder Shares will vest and shall no longer be subject to the Sponsor Transfer Restrictions if the BTC VWAP (as defined
below) equals or exceeds $140,000 during any five-day period during the Earnout Period</ix:nonNumeric></span> (the &#8220;<span style="text-decoration: underline">BTC Price Trigger Event</span>&#8221;).</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">In
the event that neither a Share Price Trigger Event nor a BTC Price Trigger Event has occurred on or prior to the second anniversary of
the Closing Date, then, subject to the terms and conditions of the Sponsor Earnout Agreement, on such second anniversary, 100% of the
Earnout Founder Shares will vest and will no longer be subject to the Sponsor Transfer Restrictions.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Notwithstanding
the foregoing, in the event that during the Earnout Period, the Company is subject to a change of control and the implied consideration
per share of Pubco Stock pursuant to which the Company or its stockholders have the right to receive in such change of control equals
or exceeds $<span id="xdx_90F_eus-gaap--SaleOfStockPricePerShare_iI_c20251231__us-gaap--TypeOfArrangementAxis__custom--SponsorEarnoutAgreementMember_zmdBlj7JIWtc" title="Stock price per share"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:SaleOfStockPricePerShare" contextRef="AsOf2025-12-31_custom_SponsorEarnoutAgreementMember" id="Fact000955" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="USDPShares">10.21</ix:nonFraction></span> (or the equivalent fair market value thereof, as determined by the board of directors of the Company following the
Closing in good faith, in the event of any non-cash consideration), then, all of the Earnout Founder Shares that have not previously
vested will vest and shall no longer be subject to the Sponsor Transfer Restrictions.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify"></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#8220;BTC
VWAP&#8221; means the dollar volume-weighted average price for Bitcoin (BTC) during any one hundred twenty (120)-hour period ending at
the time of determination, as reported by Bloomberg through its &#8220;VAP&#8221; function for &#8220;XBTUSD BGN Currency&#8221; (or
such other comparable calculation methodology as the Disinterested Independent Directors (as defined in the Sponsor Earnout Agreement)
may determine in good faith if such Bloomberg function is no longer available). If the BTC VWAP cannot be calculated for Bitcoin (BTC)
on such date on any of the foregoing bases, the BTC VWAP of Bitcoin (BTC) on such date shall be the fair market value as determined by
the Disinterested Independent Directors of the Company acting in good faith. All such determinations shall be appropriately adjusted
for any stock dividend, stock split, stock combination, recapitalization or other similar transaction during such period.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Effective

<span id="xdx_90C_eus-gaap--SharesIssued_iI_c20251203__us-gaap--TypeOfArrangementAxis__custom--SellerEarnoutAgreementMember_zYVLPhPFA085" title="Shares issued"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:SharesIssued" contextRef="AsOf2025-12-03_custom_SellerEarnoutAgreementMember" id="Fact000957" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="Shares">9,500,000</ix:nonFraction></span> shares of Pubco Stock (such shares subject to earnout, the &#8220;<span style="text-decoration: underline">Earnout Seller Shares</span>&#8221;), representing all of

only if certain price targets are achieved during the Earnout Period. The Seller Earnout Agreement provides that the Earnout Seller Shares
shall vest and shall no longer be subject to the Seller Transfer Restrictions as follows:</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#9679;<span id="xdx_908_ecustom--SharePriceTriggerEventDescription_c20251203__20251203__us-gaap--TypeOfArrangementAxis__custom--SellerEarnoutAgreementMember_zHHay6uQGBDl" title="Share price trigger event description"><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2025-12-032025-12-03_custom_SellerEarnoutAgreementMember" id="Fact000959" name="BRR:SharePriceTriggerEventDescription">100%
of the Earnout Seller Shares will vest and shall no longer be subject to the Seller Transfer Restrictions upon a Share Price Trigger

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#9679;<span id="xdx_90D_ecustom--BtcPriceTriggerEventDescription_c20251203__20251203__us-gaap--TypeOfArrangementAxis__custom--SellerEarnoutAgreementMember_zwgagBy1WSzh" title="BTC price trigger event description"><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2025-12-032025-12-03_custom_SellerEarnoutAgreementMember" id="Fact000961" name="BRR:BtcPriceTriggerEventDescription">100%
of the Earnout Seller Shares will vest and shall no longer be subject to the Seller Transfer Restrictions upon a BTC Price Trigger Event.</ix:nonNumeric></span></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">In
the event that neither a Share Price Trigger Event nor a BTC Price Trigger Event has occurred on or prior to the second anniversary of

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Notwithstanding
the foregoing, in the event that during the Earnout Period, the Company is subject to a change of control and the implied consideration
per share of Pubco Stock pursuant to which the Company or its stockholders have the right to receive in such change of control equals
or exceeds $<span id="xdx_905_eus-gaap--SaleOfStockPricePerShare_iI_c20251231__us-gaap--TypeOfArrangementAxis__custom--SellerEarnoutAgreementMember_zNX6taOkpIBg" title="Stock price per share"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:SaleOfStockPricePerShare" contextRef="AsOf2025-12-31_custom_SellerEarnoutAgreementMember" id="Fact000963" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="USDPShares">10.21</ix:nonFraction></span> (or the equivalent fair market value thereof, as determined by the board of directors of the Company following the

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>Put
Option Derivative Liability</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">On
December 23, 2025 and December 24, 2025, ProCap Financial, Inc. entered into Bitcoin put option contracts with FalconX that obligate
ProCap to buy Bitcoin at a fixed strike price if exercised by the counterparty on the January 30, 2026 expiration date. The
aggregate premium for the put option contracts was $<span id="xdx_90E_ecustom--PremiumPutOptionContracts_iI_c20251223_zkY1zVIev2Aa" title="Premium put option contracts"><span id="xdx_901_ecustom--PremiumPutOptionContracts_iI_c20251224_zeNORRImYA99" title="Premium put option contracts"><ix:nonFraction name="BRR:PremiumPutOptionContracts" contextRef="AsOf2025-12-23" id="Fact000965" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="0" unitRef="USD"><ix:nonFraction name="BRR:PremiumPutOptionContracts" contextRef="AsOf2025-12-24" id="Fact000967" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="0" unitRef="USD">534,500</ix:nonFraction></ix:nonFraction></span></span>,
which constitute freestanding derivative instruments and are recorded as a derivative liability on the consolidated balance
sheet. The Company does not hedge the put option derivative liability on the consolidate balance sheet and therefore the
Company is exposed to market risks related to Bitcoin prices and liquidity risks regarding potential cash flow if the option is exercised.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">As
of December 31, 2025, the fair value of the put option contracts was $<span id="xdx_902_ecustom--FairValueOfPutOptionContracts_iI_c20251231_zO4EOX23mMah" title="Fair value of put option contracts"><ix:nonFraction name="BRR:FairValueOfPutOptionContracts" contextRef="AsOf2025-12-31" id="Fact000969" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="0" unitRef="USD">428,236</ix:nonFraction></span>,
and ProCap recognized a $<span id="xdx_90C_ecustom--FairValueOfSoldPutOptionLiability_iI_c20251231_zQ8lWDWWoZLc" title="Fair value of sold put option liability"><ix:nonFraction name="BRR:FairValueOfSoldPutOptionLiability" contextRef="AsOf2025-12-31" id="Fact000971" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="0" unitRef="USD">106,264</ix:nonFraction></span>
change in fair value of derivative securities in other income (expense) on the consolidated statement of operations.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Pursuant
to the terms of the put option agreements, ProCap was required to post cash collateral to support its obligations under the contracts.
As of December 31, 2025, ProCap had $<span id="xdx_90C_eus-gaap--PaymentsOfDerivativeIssuanceCosts_c20251231__20251231_zADy0GLkRXE6" title="Derivative security"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:PaymentsOfDerivativeIssuanceCosts" contextRef="From2025-12-312025-12-31" id="Fact000973" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="0" unitRef="USD">4,645,780</ix:nonFraction></span> of cash collateral held in a tri-party custodial agreement with BitGo, which is presented
as restricted cash on the consolidated balance sheet. The posted collateral is not netted against the fair value of the put option liability.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify"></p>

</ix:nonNumeric><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2025-06-17to2025-12-31" escape="true" id="Fact001013" name="us-gaap:SegmentReportingDisclosureTextBlock"><p id="xdx_80F_eus-gaap--SegmentReportingDisclosureTextBlock_zIuOqYDe3pJ4" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>Note
16. <span id="xdx_827_zHlNxxE5stIg">Segment Information</span></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">ASC
Topic 280, &#8220;Segment Reporting,&#8221; establishes standards for companies to report in their financial statement information about
operating segments, products, services, geographic areas, and major customers. Operating segments are defined as components of an enterprise
that engage in business activities from which it may recognize revenues and incur expenses, and for which separate financial information
is available that is regularly evaluated by the Company&#8217;s chief operating decision maker, or group, in deciding how to allocate
resources and assess performance.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><span id="xdx_902_eus-gaap--SegmentReportingCodmProfitLossMeasureHowUsedDescription_c20250617__20251231_z5nMLdj5X9Q" title="Segment reporting CODM description"><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2025-06-17to2025-12-31" id="Fact001015" name="us-gaap:SegmentReportingCodmProfitLossMeasureHowUsedDescription">The
Company&#8217;s chief operating officer decision maker (&#8220;CODM&#8221;) has been identified as the Chief Executive Officer, who uses
cash flows as the primary measure to manage the business and does not segment the business for internal reporting or decision making.
Accordingly, management has determined that there is only <span id="xdx_909_eus-gaap--NumberOfReportableSegments_dc_uSegment_c20250617__20251231_zNds7wJPwlf9" title="Number of reportable segments"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:NumberOfReportableSegments" contextRef="From2025-06-17to2025-12-31" id="Fact001017" format="ixt-sec:numwordsen" decimals="INF" unitRef="Segment">one</ix:nonFraction></span> reportable segment.</ix:nonNumeric></span></span></p>

<ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2025-06-17to2025-12-31" escape="true" id="Fact001027" name="BRR:LeasesDisclosureTextBlock"><p id="xdx_801_ecustom--LeasesDisclosureTextBlock_za9eoWBiW5qc" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>Note
17. <span id="xdx_828_zZwAP8wRz1Ch">Leases</span></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>&#160;</b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Company leases its office facility under a month-to month operating lease arrangement. The Company has elected the short-term lease practical
expedient under ASC 842 for this lease and therefore does not recognize a right-of-use asset or lease liability on the consolidated balance
sheet for this arrangement.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

expense for this month-to month lease is recognized on a straight-line basis and were $<span id="xdx_908_eus-gaap--LeaseCost_c20251001__20251231_zZy1IVN2kQG" title="Lease cost"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:LeaseCost" contextRef="From2025-10-012025-12-31" id="Fact001029" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="0" unitRef="USD">19,600</ix:nonFraction></span> per month for the period from October
2025 to December 2025. Because the lease is cancellable at any time with no significant penalty, the Company is not committed to future
minimum lease payments beyond the monthly term.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>
Agreement and Plan of Merger</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif"></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">On
February 9, 2026 the Company entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger (the &#8220;Merger Agreement&#8221;) with Silvia Merger Sub,
Inc., a Delaware corporation and a direct wholly owned subsidiary of the Company (&#8220;Merger Sub&#8221;), CFO Silvia, Inc, a Delaware
corporation (&#8220;CFO Silvia&#8221;), Inflection Points Inc, a Delaware corporation (&#8220;Inflection Points&#8221;), Shain Noor (&#8220;Noor&#8221;
and, together with Inflection Points, the &#8220;Sellers&#8221;), and Shain Noor, solely in his capacity as the stockholder representative
(the &#8220;Stockholder Representative&#8221;). Under the Merger Agreement, Merger Sub will merge with and into CFO Silvia, with CFO
Silvia surviving as a direct wholly owned subsidiary of the Company (the &#8220;Merger&#8221; or the &#8220;Proposed Transaction&#8221;).</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">At
the effective time of the Merger (the &#8220;Effective Time&#8221;), each share of CFO Silvia common stock outstanding immediately
prior to the Effective Time (other than dissenting shares and treasury shares) will be converted into the right to receive shares of
common stock of the Company, par value $<span id="xdx_90F_eus-gaap--CommonStockParOrStatedValuePerShare_iI_pid_c20260208__us-gaap--SubsequentEventTypeAxis__us-gaap--SubsequentEventMember_zhzi1UKVgmx9" title="Common stock, par value"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:CommonStockParOrStatedValuePerShare" contextRef="AsOf2026-02-08_us-gaap_SubsequentEventMember" id="Fact001057" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="USDPShares">0.001</ix:nonFraction></span>
per share (the &#8220;Company Common Stock&#8221;), consisting of (i) the per share merger consideration, and (ii) any per share
earnout consideration, in each case as described in the Merger Agreement and related spreadsheet to be delivered prior to closing.
In addition, each outstanding simple agreement for future equity (&#8220;SAFE&#8221;) will be terminated at the Effective Time, and
each SAFE holder will be entitled to receive a portion of the total merger consideration and earnout shares (if any), in accordance
with the Merger Agreement. A portion of the merger consideration otherwise payable to equity holders will be deposited into an
escrow account for a period of twelve months to secure indemnification obligations. The shares of Company Common Stock issued in the
Merger will be subject to transfer restrictions, including lock-up provisions, as further described in the Merger
Agreement.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Subject
to the terms and conditions of the Merger Agreement, during the earnout period, if the volume-weighted trading price of the Company Common
Stock equals or exceeds $<span id="xdx_900_eus-gaap--SharePrice_iI_pid_c20260208__us-gaap--SubsequentEventTypeAxis__us-gaap--SubsequentEventMember__us-gaap--TypeOfArrangementAxis__custom--MergerAgreementMember_zRPXAf4A1as8" title="Price per share"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:SharePrice" contextRef="AsOf2026-02-08_us-gaap_SubsequentEventMember_custom_MergerAgreementMember" id="Fact001059" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" unitRef="USDPShares">9.00</ix:nonFraction></span> on the applicable measurement date, the Company will issue the earnout shares within ten business days
following such date; provided that any earnout shares deliverable to Noor are conditioned upon his continued employment and good standing
through the earnout release date, subject to certain exceptions. The earnout may only be achieved and paid once, and Company&#8217;s
earnout obligations terminate upon issuance of the earnout shares or expiration of the earnout period.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

general, the Merger is intended to qualify as a &#8220;reorganization&#8221; within the meaning of Section 368(a) of the Internal Revenue
Code of 1986, as amended, and the Merger Agreement is intended to constitute a plan of reorganization thereunder.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

and the receipt of requisite approvals from CFO Silvia stockholders and Company stockholders, among other conditions set forth in the
